items.title: Lamarck ka nazariya aur zarafa (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Lamarck's theory (PDF 223-224).

blocks.text: 1809 mein Lamarck ne 'Philosophie Zoologique' (Zoological Philosophy) shaya ki jis mein tadreeji tabdeeli ka khayal pesh kiya jo ab Lamarckism kehlata hai. Un ke tajweez kardah tareeqe ke do hisse the.

items: Aaza ka istemal aur adam istemal: jab jandar ka mahol badalta hai to woh kuch aaza zyada aur kuch kam use karta hai; zyada use hone wale aaza taraqqi kar ke mazboot hote aur na use hone wale kamzor ho jate hain. Lamarck ne lambe istemal ya adam istemal se aane wali in tabdeeliyon ko hasil shuda khasiyatein (acquired characters) kaha.

Hasil shuda khasiyaton ki virasat: jandar ki zindagi mein hasil khasiyatein us ke bachchon mein jati hain; naslon tak virasat mein ja kar yeh jandaron ko mahol ki tabdeeliyon ke liye behtar dhaal deti hain.

blocks.text: Lamarckism ke mutabiq zarafon ke buzurgon ki gardanein chhoti theen aur woh ghaas ya chhote paudon ke patte khate the. Jab chhote paude dastiyab na rahe to kuch afraad ne oonche darakhton ke patte pane ke liye gardanein khenchna shuru kiya; zindagi mein un ki gardanein mazboot aur lambi huin, yaani hasil shuda khasiyat. Un ke bachche zara lambi gardan ke saath paida hue, khenchte rahe, aur kai naslon mein lambi gardan wale zarafe ban gaye.

blocks.alt: Oopar qatar, Lamarck: zarafe ke chaar khaake jin ki gardan chhoti gardan wale buzurgon se, patton ke liye khinchne, lambi gardan aage dene, aur lambi gardan wale zarafon tak lambi hoti jati hai. Neeche qatar, Darwin: mukhtalif gardan ki lambai ke saath paida hone wale zarafe, lambi gardan wale khana pa kar zinda rehte, aur un ke bachche yeh khasiyat phailate hain.
blocks.caption: Lamarck ka zarafa aur Darwin ki wazahat (Figure 24.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Lamarck ne zarafe ki lambi gardan ko istemal aur adam istemal aur hasil shuda khasiyaton ki virasat se samjhaya: jab neechi jhaarion ki kami hui to chhoti gardan wale buzurgon ne oonche darakhton ke patte pane ke liye gardan khenchi, zindagi mein un ki gardanein lambi huin, aur yeh hasil shuda khasiyat bachchon ko mili, is liye naslon mein gardanein lambi hoti gayin. Muqable ke liye dikhayi gayi Darwin ki wazahat yeh hai ke gardanon ki lambai paidaish se hi mukhtalif thi; lambi gardan wale zarafe zyada khana pa kar zinda rahe aur zyada nasl barhayi, is liye lambi gardanein aam ho gayin.

blocks.prompt: Darwin zarafe ki lambi gardan ke baare mein is ke bajaye kya kehte?
blocks.explanation: Gardan ki lambai paidaish se mukhtalif thi; lambi gardan wale zarafe zyada khana pa kar zinda rahe aur zyada nasl barhayi, is liye yeh khasiyat aam hui.
